title: ctenitis catocarpa
intro: Ctenitis catocarpa, commonly known as Tree Fern, is a plant species belonging to the family Dryopteridaceae. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as wound healing and pain relief. The bioactive constituents of Ctenitis catocarpa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. These compounds have been found to exhibit significant anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, making the plant a potential source of novel natural products.
